MedForge-90K
	

MedForge-90K is a large-scale benchmark for interpretable medical deepfake detection under realistic text-guided lesion editing on authentic scans. It pairs real clinical-style images with high-fidelity forged counterparts (lesion implant/edit and removal), and provides pixel-level edit localization plus expert-aligned, visually grounded chain-of-thought supervision for forgery-aware reasoning.
